tools.name: repl_eval
tools.description: Evaluate Clojure in this session's SCI worker and return its value: a string as plain text, any other value as EDN. Definitions persist across calls in the same session. Send one or more forms; they run in order and the last value is the result. A def shows its var name, so definitions need no trailing nil. The value of every result is also bound to last-result. Helpers: (parse-long s) returns an integer or nil; context-lines is the context as a vector of lines; (page v offset n) returns n characters of v's printed text from offset; subs is bounded to the string and nil-safe, so (subs s 0 3000) never fails on a shorter or missing s; (index-of coll x) is the first index of x in a string or sequence, or -1, since .indexOf works on strings only; (pairs-of ids) prints every unordered pair of distinct ids as (a, b) lines, lower id first; (user-records u) returns user u's record texts; (selection-audit pred ids) rechecks a user selection: which selected users have no record matching pred and which matching users were not selected.
